answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond that vests only after a history of useful work, like a pearl forming layer by layer rather than appearing overnight. A newcomer starts in a shallow lagoon of low-trust tasks with capped payments, and only graduates to the open meadow of high-value jobs after verified deliveries. Creating a thousand fake identities then means funding a thousand bonds and doing a thousand units of real work first, which costs more than any fraud those identities could extract.
